reviews.title: A pretty good experience thus far
reviews.text: It’s been a serious ride, no pun intended, using this app betting on horses. It’s certainly won me money (and lost me money other times). They are legitimate in the payouts and the app is entertaining. I only bet on big races at this point, however, as this allows me to space out the gambling a bit and allows more insights into the horses in the race I’m betting on. I’d never recommend gambling, but this is an ok way to do it. Updated 5/1/2026
